manifest.title: Local (Express + SQLite + Vue)
manifest.description: Runs on this computer only: an Express API, a SQLite file for data (Node's built-in node:sqlite), and a Vue screen. No cloud account, no billing.

spec.title: Write the spec
spec.description: Fills in the spec templates for the base and the use case from the answers to the questions. Anything not yet decided goes on a list.

prerequisites.title: Check the tools
prerequisites.description: Checks Node (a version that has node:sqlite) and yarn.

scaffold.title: App skeleton
scaffold.description: Creates the Express API, SQLite, the Vue screens and the starting point for tests, all in one folder.

data.title: Data shape
data.description: Turns the "things it handles" in the spec into SQLite tables, and writes migrations that can rebuild them, plus tests.

api.title: API
api.description: Turns the operations in the spec into an API, checks what comes in, and writes tests.

ui.title: Screens
ui.description: Builds the screens in the spec with Vue and connects them to the API.

auth.title: Sign-in
auth.description: Adds the sign-in method in the spec (if none is needed, makes the app open only from this computer).

run-check.title: Start it and check
run-check.description: Builds it for production, starts it, and checks that the screens and the API respond.

security.title: Security check
security.description: Reads what was built the way an attacker would, following OWASP Top 10:2025, fixes the holes that can be exploited, confirms the fixes with tests, and writes a report. The result is checked by sending the running server requests shaped like real attacks (a different Host name, changes from another site, broken JSON).

handover.title: How to use it, and backups
handover.description: Writes in the README how to start it, where the data file is, and how to back it up.
